text:
sara: quick topic for roadmap sync 1: customers asking for clearer SLO-driven dashboards + tenant-level cost tagging. want to propose a small scoped plan: SLO cards + cost allocation tags + opt-in sampling per-tenant. thoughts?
jules: yes please. the SLO cards should map errors/latency to routes and model versions, not just service-level aggregates.
max: agree. practical scope idea:
- dashboard cards: SLO status (green/yellow/red), burn rate, and recent regressions
- cost tagging: surface per-tenant and per-feature tags (from request metadata) so finance can allocate
- sampling: lightweight request sampling that can be toggled per-tenant with a ceiling to avoid cost shock
tori: small ask: add a reconciliation export for billing so customers can match console numbers to invoices. even CSV is fine.
sara: acceptance criteria draft:
- SLO card showing current health and 30d trend for any selected route/model/version
- ability to click into failing SLO from card -> top 5 contributing traces/log examples
- per-tenant cost tag UI: show top 10 tenants by spend and ability to filter dashboard by tenant
- sampling controls in admin with default sampling 0.05% and max 1% per-tenant
- CSV export with token-level breakdown and tag columns
jules: rollout plan suggestion:
1) impl backend aggregator for SLO + tagging (2 sprints)
2) simple UI cards + CSV export (1 sprint)
3) sampling runtime + admin controls (1 sprint)
4) internal canary -> 2 pilot customers -> GA
max: gating metrics for GA:
- SLO accuracy: sampled traces must correlate with dashboard alerts in 90% of cases (i.e., traces explain the alert)
- sampling overhead: < 1% p95 increase for instrumented routes
- customer billing delta: console vs invoice < 3% after reconciliation for pilot customers
tori: compliance must be baked in. sampling must strip PII by default and provide an org-level kill switch.
sara: good catch. add to acceptance: data-masking applied by default and kill-switch present in admin.
ijules: (typo) i meant @jules : )
max: we should also add a small anomaly detector for sudden cost spikes, alert to SRE + customer owner. even a simple threshold rule would help customers catch broken prompts or runaway loops.
sara: keep anomaly detector as stretch but include a simple threshold alerting config in MVP.
infra-bot: infra-bot: SLO-agg-service branch created: feature/slo-cost-tags (CI passed) :rocket:
jules: timeline ask: can we aim for pilot in 7 weeks? depends on infra capacity; will need one infra engineer full-time first 3 weeks.
max: dev plan: week1-2 aggregator + proto API; week3 UI skim + export; week4 sampling runtime + admin; week5-6 internal canary and pilot onboarding; week7 iterate on pilot feedback.
tori: onboarding checklist for pilots:
- enable tenant tags on their account
- baseline triage time and current dashboard exports (30d)
- access to pilot CSV reconciliation template
- signed data-processing note for sampling (if needed)
sara: who wants to own pilot coordination? @tori?
tori: i can own onboarding + compliance checks. need support from solutions-eng for customer access.
jules: i'll own the PRD and the acceptance gates doc. will drop link when ready.
max: one operational note: make tag ingestion resilient to malformed tags and cap cardinality by normalizing to known tag keys. don't let customers blow up the UI with too many ad-hoc tags.
sara: agreed. cap keys, normalize values, surface unknowns as "other".
infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature/slo-cost-tags deployed to staging at 2024-10-10T09:05Z :white_check_mark:
sara: great. next steps: jules drop PRD, max open sprint tickets, tori prepare pilot invites. we'll review progress in 1-week check-in.
max: i'll post the sprint-board link here when created.
jules: PRD draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/obs-slo-cost-mvp (WIP)
sara: end thread 1 60 - adding to next sync agenda 'slo-cost tagging pilot' :thinking_face:
